_about: Known violations of the p10 invariants, by invariant and object identifier, each with its reason: the source is printed so, a substitute-font defect, a genuine value of that shape, or a named rule gap left open. A case that no longer fails must leave this list (p10 reports it as stale). Identifiers and reasons only, no print text beyond a few identifying words.

year.A2/F/p363l10#2: The Addendum II working file holds a review dated 2020, later than the letter of 2009 that otherwise bounds the file; the date is printed so.
year.A2/L/p1264l18#2: The same review of 2020 printed a second time in the secondary literature of Addendum II.
